newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova raises discount rate to 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Moldova raises discount rate to 20 pct.

text.p: Moldova's central bank has raised its official discount rate to 20 percent annual from 18 percent, a bank official said.
The new rate was set at a credit funds auction on Monday, where nine banks bought a total of 15.83 million lei ($3.44 million) of central bank reserves.

Officials say the bank's loans to the Moldovan economy will grow by 472 million lei ($102.6 million), or 32 percent in 1997. The central bank expects 1997 annual inflation to fall to 10-13 percent from 15.1 percent in 1996 and 23.8 percent in 1995.
